newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners remain major yen bond buyers in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners remain major yen bond buyers in Nov.

text.p: Foreigners continued to be major buyers of yen bonds in November, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Friday.
Foreigners' net purchases in November totalled 968.5 billion yen, down from a record 3.1288 trillion yen in October.
But foreigners remained the biggest net buyers within the investor category.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills (T-bills), corporate bonds and bank debentures.
The vast bulk of foreigners' buying, 959.4 billion yen worth, was in T-bills.
